## Extend clip

Open Video Studio, find a video in Recent clips and choose **Extend clip**. Describe what happens next. Put spoken words in quotation marks, or enter a line under **Dialogue and ending image**. An optional image can guide the final look.

Workbench carries forward the original picture and soundtrack, uses the saved studio singer’s voice settings for dialogue, and saves a new MP4. A scene can progress from speech into laughter and a visual transformation in the same camera shot. The final length follows the recorded dialogue, up to three minutes total.

The public [rock film](https://calemediadev.github.io/cale-ai-workbench-downloads/films/last-light-at-the-rink.mp4) now opens directly from the concert poster. The GitHub player is also available on the [showcase page](https://github.com/CaleMediaDev/cale-ai-workbench-downloads#last-light-at-the-rink).

### Verification

A real Windows 11 Video Studio run extended a three-second rehearsal clip into an 18-second film with dialogue, laughter and a transformation. The first 72 decoded picture frames matched the original exactly. The machine completed the render in 18 minutes 24 seconds on an RTX 3060 with 12 GB of VRAM.

The signed Windows package passed [fresh x64 installation checks](https://github.com/CaleMediaDev/cale-ai-workbench-downloads/actions/runs/45378330630). The public concert passed the [anonymous playback check](https://github.com/CaleMediaDev/cale-ai-workbench-downloads/actions/runs/45377681363).
